title.zh: 从 800 行规则开始，看见真正的故障
title.en: The failure hidden inside an 800-line rulebook

description.zh: 先认识这位开发者在做什么。刘俊毅的案例是一款 Cocos Creator 微信小游戏：客户端、服务端、协议与需求分处四个仓库，不同角色要交接工作。他希望 AI 按设计实施，于是不断补充 Skill 和约束，从五百多行涨到八百多行，还列出必须遵守的规则。结果却是：步骤仍会跳过，到了下一阶段，前面的要求又可能失踪。
description.en: Start with the actual project. Liu Junyi was building a Cocos Creator game for WeChat. The client, server, protocol and product requirements lived in four repositories, with different roles handing work to one another. To keep AI on track, he expanded a Skill and its instructions from over 500 lines to over 800 and added rules it was supposed to obey. Steps still went missing; requirements disappeared between stages.

title.zh: 有些规则应该被执行，有些知识应该等用到再读
title.en: Some rules belong in code. Some knowledge can wait

description.zh: 这个案例还记录了一类常见故障：某种跨分包的静态导入在编辑器里没出事，真机首次加载却崩了。把教训继续塞进提示词，等于每次都期待模型记住；写成检查脚本，则能在提交前确定地指出哪里违反了约束。
description.en: The same case describes an import between game packages that worked in the editor but crashed on a real device’s first load. Repeating the lesson in a prompt asks the model to remember it every time. A checking script can identify the violation before submission.

title.zh: 子 Agent 让工作并行，也让理解重新开始
title.en: A subagent can parallelize work and restart understanding

description.zh: 本周另一篇关键阅读来自 Anthropic。它建议一些企业系统把高度关联的子 Agent 收回主循环，通过 Skills 与工具承载专门知识；理由之一是，多次交接会带来上下文损耗与额外等待。但它也明确保留了使用子 Agent 的场景，包括上下文隔离、独立并行和相互冲突的工具环境。 官方原文
description.en: Another central reading comes from Anthropic. For some enterprise systems, it recommends folding closely related subagents into a main loop, moving specialist procedures into Skills and tools. Handoffs can lose context and add latency. It also retains reasons to use subagents: context isolation, independent parallel work and conflicting tool environments.  Official article

title.zh: 为什么另一位架构师仍然鼓励多开几个 Agent？
title.en: Why does another architect still favor several agents?

description.zh: InfoQ 这周转述的 Carlos Kelkboom 访谈，提供了一个很好的反例：架构与代码骨架由人掌握，再让多个 Agent 探索实现；对自己已经看不懂的代码，宁愿在隔离分支重来，也不继续叠补丁。
description.en: An InfoQ translation of a Carlos Kelkboom interview supplies a useful counterpoint. Keep the architecture and skeleton understandable to a human, then let agents explore implementations. When generated code becomes unintelligible, he prefers restarting in isolation to accumulating more patches.

title.zh: 减法有没有做对，要看原来会的事还会不会
title.en: Did the simplification preserve what already worked?

description.zh: 合并之后跑得快，只完成了一半验证。Anthropic 的示例里，合并客服角色降低了延迟，却漏掉原本能给出的送达日期；问题只在重复运行中暴露出来。
description.en: A faster merged system is only half a result. In Anthropic’s support example, a merge reduced latency but dropped a delivery date the earlier system supplied. Repeated runs exposed the failure.

title.zh: Jev 的点赞争议：可疑的热度，不是能力裁决
title.en: Jev’s likes: suspicious popularity is not a capability verdict

description.zh: 我们在创刊号介绍过 Jev 的决策模型。本周 AGI Hunt 的另一篇文章检查了 Hugging Face 上一个 JEV-27B-VL AutoTrust 模型的点赞账号：作者统计的 6,878 个账号中，94% 的注册时间落在模型发布前 60 天以内或发布之后。作为对照，文中几个模型的相同指标低得多。
description.en: Our first issue explored Jev’s decision models. This week, AGI Hunt examined the accounts liking a JEV-27B-VL AutoTrust model on Hugging Face. In the author’s dataset of 6,878 accounts, 94% were registered within 60 days before the model’s release or after it. The same measure was much lower for several comparison models.

title.zh: 98% 的物理题：更强的计算助手，怎样走向研究？
title.en: The 98% physics result: a stronger assistant, on which work?

description.zh: 另一篇收藏的标题把结果概括成「解决 98% 世界物理难题」。回到 TheoPhysEval 论文，范围要窄得多，也因此更有研究价值：50 道未发表、答案可核验的理论物理研究级问题，允许 Agent 查文献、编写数值或符号计算脚本。论文报告，Codex 中的 GPT-6 Astra 得到最终答案的准确率为 98%，平均每题成本低于 3 美元。 论文
description.en: A saved headline described the result as solving 98% of the world’s physics problems. TheoPhysEval has a narrower and more useful scope: 50 unpublished research-level theoretical physics problems with verifiable answers. Agents could consult literature and write numerical or symbolic scripts. The paper reports 98% final-answer accuracy for GPT-6 Astra in Codex, at an average cost below USD 3 per problem.  Paper

title.zh: Lovart 2.0 · Arti
title.en: Lovart 2.0 · Arti

description.en: Brings personal memory, design research, canvas checks and recurring briefs into one workflow.

title.zh: Apple Bots
title.en: Apple Bots

description.zh: Pi Durable 的社区探索：把持久任务接入 Swift 与 Apple 框架。
description.en: A community Pi Durable experiment connecting durable tasks to Swift and Apple frameworks.

title.zh: Expand Fetch
title.en: Expand Fetch

description.zh: 提取渲染后的网页内容，尽量保住表格、视觉符号与页面信息的关系。
description.en: Extracts rendered pages while aiming to preserve tables, visual cues and their meaning.

title.zh: past.dev
title.en: past.dev

description.zh: 带时间和来源的记忆检索，关注事实更新以后，旧值怎样被替换。
description.en: Memory retrieval with dates and sources, emphasizing how changed facts replace old values.

title.zh: earshot
title.en: earshot

description.zh: 把声音转成描述、时间线与测量结果，让编程 Agent 获得音频反馈。
description.en: Turns sound into descriptions, timelines and measurements a coding agent can inspect.

title.zh: Reason Network
title.en: Reason Network

description.zh: 让不同电脑与工具里的编程 Agent 互相提问、交接明确的小任务。
description.en: Lets coding agents across machines and tools ask each other questions and hand over bounded tasks.

title.zh: Unscroll
title.en: Unscroll

description.zh: 用应用限时和主动屏蔽，减少无意识刷手机的时间。
description.en: Uses app limits and deliberate blocking to interrupt habitual scrolling.

title.en: Inflight

description.en: Pins comments to specific prototype elements and passes feedback into implementation.

title.zh: 十个 Bot，十个具体任务
title.en: Ten bots, ten concrete jobs

description.zh: 从追踪承诺到整理书签，完整保留 kaito 的十个 Grok Bot 推荐。
description.en: All ten Grok Bot recommendations from kaito, from tracking commitments to sorting bookmarks.

title.zh: 两封通讯里的延伸阅读
title.en: More threads from two newsletters

description.zh: AIGC Weekly #193 与 DEX #368：模型更新、设计资源、产品作者性与协作。
description.en: AIGC Weekly #193 and DEX #368: model updates, design resources, product authorship and collaboration.

title.zh: 新人需要的，可能是另一种练习场
title.en: Newcomers may need a different practice ground

description.zh: APPSO 对 Anthropic 内部工作的解读，是上期周日补记的另一篇文章，本期正式区间再次收录。它关注 AI 使用深入工作以后，初级岗位与培养方式会受到什么影响。这是对一家公司的材料和组织变化的讨论，不足以外推整个行业的招聘命运。
description.en: APPSO’s account of work inside Anthropic was the other Sunday addition to issue 004, now within this issue’s regular period. It asks how deeper AI use changes junior roles and development. Material from one company cannot determine the hiring outlook of an entire industry.

title.zh: 公益基金的重点，是股权与分配规则
title.en: A public-benefit fund is about equity and distribution rules

description.zh: 另一条新闻把 Anthropic 的公益基金写成了「捐 3200 亿分给普通人」。官方公告承诺的是股权安排：经股东批准后投入 5% 股份，并设定随估值变化、由董事会酌情追加的机制；面向特定人群的直接分配只是可能探索的方式之一。它不是已经到账的现金，也没有公布面向所有人的统一发放方案。 官方公告
description.en: Another headline turned Anthropic’s fund into a vast cash donation to ordinary people. The official announcement concerns equity: subject to shareholder approval, a 5% stake, with a mechanism for discretionary additions as company value increases. Direct distributions to specific populations are one possible use. It is not money already received by households or a published universal payout program.  Official announcement

title.zh: Agent 1.0、2.0 之外，用户愿意留下什么？
title.en: Beyond “Agent 1.0” and “2.0,” what makes a user stay?

description.zh: 特工宇宙把 QClaw、元器等产品的调整，解释为从「搭 Agent 的平台」转向「直接替人工作的 Agent」。其中的「1.0 / 2.0」是文章的叙事框架，本刊也未独立确认文中全部下架时间。
description.en: Agent Universe interprets changes around QClaw and Yuanqi as a shift from platforms for building agents toward agents that directly perform work. Its “1.0 / 2.0” labels are an editorial frame, not a technical standard. This issue has not independently confirmed every shutdown date reported there.

title.zh: 一台旧 Kindle，让「自己做」重新有趣
title.en: An old Kindle made making things enjoyable again

description.zh: APPSO 的作者用 GPT-6 改造一台旧 Kindle，把它变成联网相框。文章的乐趣不在于自动生成了多少代码，而在于一块真实的墨水屏会给反馈：显示效果、刷新残影、网络与设备状态，都需要人拿在手里观察，再和 AI 一起调整。
description.en: An APPSO writer used GPT-6 to turn an old Kindle into a connected photo frame. The interest lies less in how much code appeared than in a real e-ink screen providing feedback: image quality, ghosting, networking and device state all had to be observed and adjusted with the AI.

title.zh: 一键通关之后，失落也不是矫情
title.en: An easy finish can still feel empty

description.zh: 卡兹克的文章写出了另一面：AI 让做产品与生成内容越来越轻松，他反而难以从中获得原来的快乐。文中借游戏开了修改器之后失去兴致的经历，描述一种目标还在、过程却被抽空的感觉；结尾没有声称解决了虚无，而是把注意力重新放在仍想探索的支线上。
description.en: Kazik’s essay describes the other side. Building products and generating content became easier with AI, yet the old enjoyment faded. An experience of losing interest in a game after using cheats becomes a way of describing goals that remain while the journey feels hollow. The ending does not claim to solve that feeling; it returns to side paths still worth exploring.

title.zh: 光环不会替你理解用户
title.en: Credentials cannot understand a customer for you

description.zh: 地心引力这封短通讯收了法国与中美模式的文章、播客，也提到「字节掘金者：最贵的是光环」。与本期相关的，是它对应用创业的提醒：漂亮履历和资本投入，无法保证做出让人愿意使用的产品。
description.en: The saved Gravity newsletter ranges across France, comparisons of national systems and podcasts. Its reference to an article about former ByteDance employees starting companies offers the connection here: prestigious backgrounds and capital do not guarantee a product people want.
